reason: A Windows pwsh integration that reads the current workspace .env file and injects its variables into shell subprocesses, providing workspace-specific environment isolation.

summaries.zh: 该插件在每次 Windows pwsh 调用时读取当前工作区的 .env 文件，并将其中的环境变量注入子进程。
summaries.en: This plugin reads the current workspace’s .env file for each Windows pwsh invocation and injects its variables into the child process environment.

capabilities: Reads a workspace-level .env file on each pwsh invocation
Parses variable assignments and expands references from the parent environment and earlier entries
Injects parsed values into child pwsh process environments
Allows workspace .env values to override same-named inherited environment variables except DSH_* keys
